business_summary: Zhejiang Yonggui Electric Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and technical support of electrical connectors, components, and precision products in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Rail Transit and Industry, Vehicle-Mounted and Energy Information, and Special Equipment. The Rail Transit and Industry segment offers connectors, door systems, axle counting systems, railway locomotives, passenger cars, high-speed trains, urban rail transit vehicles, maglev trains, and other vehicles and rail lines; connectors and encoders for industrial robot motors and power circular connectors, industrial robot base control cabinets, and panel wiring applications; and pitch and main control cabinets used in industrial robots and wind power products. Its Vehicle-Mounted and Energy Information segment provides high-voltage connectors and wiring harnesses, mini-FAKRA, automotive ethernet connectors, high-voltage distribution boxes, charging/swapping interfaces and wiring harnesses, AC/DC charging guns, high-power liquid-cooled DC charging guns, communication power/signal connectors, energy storage connectors, and high-speed connectors. This segment also offers integrated interconnection system solutions for new electric vehicles; energy information products used in communication base stations and various communication network equipment; energy storage products used in residential, industrial, commercial, and large-scale energy storage; and charging products used in home charging piles and fast charging piles. The Special Equipment segment provides special circular electrical connectors, micro rectangular electrical connectors, RF connectors, fiber optic connectors, fluid connectors, and cabinet connectors, as well as deep-sea connectors, shore power and charging products, and underwater robot connectors. Zhejiang Yonggui Electric Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Tiantai, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Yonggui Electric Equipment Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 전기 커넥터, 부품 및 정밀 제품의 연구 개발, 제조, 판매 및 기술 지원에 종사하고 있습니다. 철도 운송 및 산업, 차량 탑재 및 에너지 정보, 특수 장비의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 철도 운송 및 산업 부문은 커넥터, 도어 시스템, 차축 계산 시스템, 철도 기관차, 승용차, 고속 열차, 도시 철도 운송 차량, 자기 부상 열차 및 기타 차량 및 철도 노선을 제공합니다. 산업용 로봇 모터 및 전원 원형 커넥터, 산업용 로봇 베이스 제어 캐비닛 및 패널 배선 애플리케이션용 커넥터 및 인코더; 산업용 로봇 및 풍력 발전 제품에 사용되는 피치 및 메인 제어 캐비닛. 차량 탑재 및 에너지 정보 부문에서는 고전압 커넥터 및 배선 하니스, 미니 FAKRA, 자동차 이더넷 커넥터, 고전압 배전함, 충전/스왑 인터페이스 및 배선 하니스, AC/DC 충전 건, 고전력 수냉식 DC 충전 건, 통신 전원/신호 커넥터, 에너지 저장 커넥터 및 고속 연결을 제공합니다.
